v200.summary: Major release: motion.dev animation system, full UI/UX redesign, Tailwind CSS support, and AI-first tooling.

changes.0: motion.dev animation system with NgxsmkMotionDirective and NgxsmkAnimateDirective for declarative enter/exit/scroll animations.
changes.1: Four gesture directives: NgxsmkHoverDirective, NgxsmkFocusDirective, NgxsmkDragDirective, and NgxsmkPressDirective.
changes.2: Tailwind CSS v3 preset and v4 CSS theme in @ngxsmk/theme for zero-config Tailwind integration.
changes.3: Component showcase page with sidebar navigation, category grouping, and StackBlitz live playground.
changes.4: Complete UI/UX redesign of the demo app: home, docs, themes, blog, and changelog pages.
changes.5: Design token replacement across 70+ components for consistent visual language.
changes.6: Deprecated @Input/@Output decorators — all APIs are now signal-only.
changes.7: Extracted CvaBase<T> abstract class into @ngxsmk/cdk/cva-base, eliminating ~80 lines of duplicated ControlValueAccessor boilerplate across 8 form components.
changes.8: Extracted ListboxKeyboard class into @ngxsmk/cdk/listbox-keyboard, unifying arrow-key, Home/End, Enter, and Escape navigation.
changes.9: Merged SearchService into ComponentRegistry, eliminating the double MiniSearch index.
changes.10: Extracted NgxThemeInjectorService for CSS injection, decoupling it from dark-mode switching.
changes.11: Extracted component token defaults from css.ts staticVars() into a COMPONENT_TOKEN_DEFAULTS registry.
changes.12: Deleted 6 orphaned renderer tokens and implementations, the CDK overlay strategy, and the unused base-typeahead skeleton.

v133.summary: Architectural deepening: CVA base class, listbox keyboard nav, and dead-code cleanup.

changes.0: Extracted CvaBase<T> abstract class into @ngxsmk/cdk/cva-base, eliminating ~80 lines of duplicated ControlValueAccessor boilerplate across 8 form components.
changes.1: Extracted ListboxKeyboard class into @ngxsmk/cdk/listbox-keyboard, unifying arrow-key, Home/End, Enter, and Escape navigation across combobox, autocomplete, multi-select, and multi-selector.
changes.2: Merged SearchService into ComponentRegistry, eliminating the double MiniSearch index. Deleted KeyboardShortcutsService (unused).
changes.3: Extracted NgxThemeInjectorService for CSS injection, decoupling it from dark-mode switching in NgxsmkThemeService.
changes.4: Extracted component token defaults from css.ts staticVars() into a COMPONENT_TOKEN_DEFAULTS registry.
changes.5: Deleted 6 orphaned renderer tokens and implementations (popover, tooltip, dialog, sheet, select, tabs), the CDK overlay strategy, and the unused base-typeahead skeleton.

v132.summary: AI-friendly tooling: MCP component database, llms.txt, and agent docs.

changes.0: The MCP server is now backed by an auto-generated database of all 214 components, powering search, API lookup, and layout tools for AI coding agents.
changes.1: Generated llms.txt and llms-full.txt API references served at the site root, plus a Claude Code skill for consumer apps.
changes.2: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md guidance for AI coding agents working in the repository.

v131.summary: Keyboard navigation, unified focus rings, and dark-mode fixes.

changes.0: Keyboard navigation for autocomplete, combobox, multi-select, and multi-selector: arrow keys, Home/End, Enter to select, and Escape to close.
changes.1: Every component now draws its focus ring from the --ngxsmk-focus-ring token, replacing three inconsistent patterns.
changes.2: prefers-reduced-motion now stops all token-driven motion, not just the shared motion duration.
changes.3: Fixed dark-mode colors in 14 components that fell back to light-only values.

v130.summary: SEO utilities, emerald default preset, and documentation improvements.

changes.0: SEO service: @ngxsmk/core/seo with NgxsmkSeoService and provideSeo() for title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter Card, robots, and JSON-LD.
changes.1: emerald is now the default preset; the astryx preset was removed.
changes.2: Richer package READMEs and top-level docs with a component catalog, CLI & schematics, and accessibility guidance.

v120.summary: Partial-Ivy build fix (resolves NG0203) and expanded component surface.

changes.0: Libraries now compile in partial Ivy mode so DI factories run inside the injection context (NG0203).
changes.3: i18n entry point with NgxsmkI18nPipe, createI18n, provideI18n, useDirection.

v110.summary: Stable release with updated toolchain, command palette, and prompt carousel.

changes.0: Command palette component (@ngxsmk/core/command-palette) for quick search and actions.
changes.1: Prompt carousel component (@ngxsmk/core/prompt-carousel) for AI-focused templates.
changes.2: Standardized workspace configuration and builder options.
changes.3: Verified Angular compatibility across versions 17 through 22.

v100.summary: First stable release of the NGXSMK ecosystem.

changes.2: 200+ components across forms, AI, enterprise, charts, and more.
changes.3: Universal token engine with runtime theme switching.
changes.4: Peer dependencies widened to >=17.3.0 (was pinned to Angular 22).

v0beta1.summary: Initial beta release of the NGXSMK ecosystem.

changes.1: 200+ components across forms, AI, enterprise, charts, and more.
changes.2: Universal token engine with runtime theme switching.

v0alpha3.summary: Preview of the showcase application and documentation site.

changes.1: Migrated all components to signal inputs.

v0alpha1.summary: First internal alpha of the core component library.

changes.0: Foundational primitives: button, card, input, dialog.

v210.summary: Ionic integration, ten new components, and packaging fixes that unblocked Angular 17 consumers.

changes.0: Ionic support: provideNgxsmkIonic() wires the platform adapter, an ion-spinner button renderer, and a safe-area bridge in one call.
changes.1: Complete Ionic token adapter — all nine color roles with their six-variable sets, the --ion-color-step ladder, surfaces, and a real dark-mode block.
changes.2: NGXSMK_PLATFORM_ADAPTER abstracts which element scrolls and where overlays attach, so overlays behave correctly inside ion-content and ion-app.
changes.3: Safe-area tokens applied to toast, sheet, mobile-nav, and the top-nav mega menu.
changes.4: Ten new components: breadcrumb, bottom-tab-bar, masked-input, response-feedback, time-picker, portal, timeline, safe-area, back-to-top, and action-sheet.
changes.5: Baseline conformance suite covering 156 previously untested components, plus an axe harness in @ngxsmk/cdk/testing.
changes.6: Declared @angular/cdk and qrcode-generator as peer dependencies — both were imported but never declared, breaking installs that used select or qr-code.
changes.7: Narrowed the ngxsmk-datepicker peer range: 2.4.0 dropped its root export, which made @ngxsmk/core/datepicker unresolvable for new installs.
changes.8: masonry-grid ignored custom item templates — the component used *ngTemplateOutlet without importing NgTemplateOutlet, so every item silently fell back to the default card.
changes.9: Accessibility fixes in status-dot, stepper, and transfer, where aria-label sat on elements ARIA forbids naming or a listbox had no accessible name.
changes.10: Button renderer selection moved to NGXSMK_BUTTON_RENDERER_CLASS, which an application can actually override — the previous token was shadowed by the directive.
changes.11: ButtonRenderer trimmed to the two methods the directive calls; the other three were never invoked.

docs.subtitle: A high-performance design system designed for modern standalone Angular apps.
docs.quickStartDesc: Install core packages and the design engine. You can copy the code directly into your terminal to start immediately.
docs.checkWebApis: Engineered with native standard Web APIs.
docs.pillarZonelessDesc: Fully decoupled from Zone.js. Components trigger standard change detection cycles via native signal notification trees for peak performance.
docs.pillarCopyPasteDesc: Directly own the source code. Component modules are scaffolded into your app files, leaving zero bloated dependencies behind in node_modules.
docs.pillarHslEngineDesc: Configure global aesthetics in HSL coordinates. Easily generate style outputs compatible with vanilla CSS, SCSS, or Tailwind configurations.
docs.aiToolingDesc: Connect the NGXSMK MCP server to give your AI assistant direct access to component search, API lookup, LLM-readable documentation, and development tools. It works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client.
docs.aiToolingMcp: MCP server with component search and API lookup
docs.aiToolingClients: Works across multiple MCP clients — Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, and Windsurf
docs.aiToolingInstall: Easy installation with a single command
docs.aiToolingInstallNote: Claude Code example — commands for Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, and Windsurf are in the docs.
docs.pillarAiFirstDesc: Ship specialized interfaces built for AI streaming, reasoning timelines, custom code editors, and floating card citation viewers.
docs.tokenThemingDesc: Dynamic themes are powered by CSS Custom Properties. Click the color presets below to see the interactive sandbox component instantaneously adapt to the new theme variables.
docs.faqZonelessAnswer: Yes! All components are designed from the ground up to operate without Zone.js. They utilize Angular's modern Signal APIs for lightweight, fine-grained reactivity, leading to much smaller bundle footprints and better runtime performance.
docs.faqTailwindLabel: Can I use it with Tailwind CSS?
docs.faqTailwindAnswer: Absolutely. NGXSMK's token engine exposes CSS custom properties (variables) that can be easily mapped in your tailwind.config.js. The design parameters are completely decoupled from any single utility framework.
docs.faqCopyPasteLabel: How does the copy-paste DX model work?
docs.faqCopyPasteAnswer: Instead of importing bloated pre-compiled modules, our CLI tool allows you to copy component source code directly into your workspace. You retain complete ownership, styling control, and structural flexibility.
docs.faqAiLabel: What AI layout modules are included?
docs.faqAiAnswer: We provide specialized interfaces built for AI chat applications, such as scroll-locked chat bubbles, streaming text responses, Reasoning Timelines, and formatted Citation card lists.

navigation.desc: Navigation primitives - from tiny breadcrumbs to full app shells - that share the theme token engine, so every link, tab, and menu recolors with your brand.
navigation.breadcrumbItemDesc: Trail of links that shows the current location. Wrap items in a nav with an aria-label; the last item renders as the active page.
navigation.outlineDesc: A page outline / table-of-contents with depth-based indentation and an active entry. Pass the items array and the active id.
navigation.tabMenuDesc: A segmented tab strip. Drop any clickable elements inside - here a set of role="tab" buttons.
navigation.navIconDesc: Compact icon-plus-label entry for vertical toolbars and rail menus. Set active and size as needed.
navigation.navHeadingMenuDesc: A label that expands into a stacked list of sub-links. Mark each entry with the nav-item attribute.
navigation.sideNavDesc: A collapsible vertical navigation shell. Group items under headings and sections; the collapse button is wired to the shell.
navigation.topNavDesc: A horizontal application bar. Combine a brand heading, active items, and a dropdown menu.
navigation.megaMenuDesc: A rich hover-revealed dropdown for the top nav: grouped columns of items plus a featured card. Hover "Products" to reveal it.
navigation.whatsNewDesc: Explore the v0.1 release notes and fresh templates.
navigation.mobileNavDesc: A slide-in drawer for small screens, opened by a hamburger toggle. The toggle emits an event to flip the open signal.
navigation.tapHint: Tap the toggle to open the drawer. (Renders as an overlay in a real app.)
navigation.linkProviderDesc: A directive that supplies a shared link template (via the NGXSMK_LINK_PROVIDER token). Drop nav links in and the active entry is highlighted.
navigation.sideNavComposedDesc: Build a vertical nav from the side-nav primitives - sections, headings, items, and a collapse button - inside a constrained container.
navigation.topNavComposedDesc: Assemble a horizontal bar from top-nav primitives - heading, items, a menu, and mega-menu cards - inside a constrained container.
navigation.dockDesc: macOS-style floating toolbar with hover magnification effects and badges.

layout.desc: Structural primitives for centering, sectioning, spacing and arranging content. Everything here is theme-aware and composable, so you can build page scaffolding without writing custom CSS.
layout.centerDesc: Centers its content on both axes. Great for empty states, heroes, and callouts.
layout.sectionDesc: A titled block that groups related content with a semantic heading.
layout.sectionsKeepScannable: Sections keep long pages scannable by pairing a heading with its body content.
layout.containerDesc: Caps content width and centers it on the page. Pick a size token to match your grid.
layout.gridDesc: A CSS grid with a configurable column count and gap. Items flow automatically.
layout.flexDesc: A flexible flexbox row/column with alignment, justification, gap, and wrapping.
layout.stacksDesc: Directional stack helpers. HStack and VStack fix the axis; Stack lets you switch at runtime via [direction]. Mark children with ngxsmkStackItem.
layout.dividerDesc: A semantic separator for horizontal rules or inline vertical dividers.
layout.aspectRatioDesc: Locks a box to a fixed width/height ratio so media never jumps while loading.
layout.spacerDesc: An empty, flexible filler that pushes siblings apart in a stack or flex row.
layout.collapsibleDesc: A disclosure widget that expands to reveal hidden content. Open state can be controlled via [open].
layout.hiddenDetails: Hidden details appear here. The open state is a two-way model, so you can drive it from your own signal if needed.
layout.resizableDesc: A panel with a drag handle on its edge to resize interactively.
layout.dragHandleResize: Drag the handle on the right edge to resize this panel.
layout.appShellDesc: A full app frame with optional top bar, sidebar, and footer. Project content via [topbar], [sidebar], and [footer].
layout.mainContentArea: Main content area. The shell handles the scaffolding so you focus on the page.
layout.formLayoutDesc: Arranges form fields into a responsive grid. Set [columns] to lay fields out side by side.
layout.resizeHandleDesc: The drag handle used to resize a panel. Compose it with any element and wire the (resizing) output to update a size signal on drag.
layout.layoutRegionsDesc: App-region layout primitives: NgxsmkLayout frames a header, content, footer and optional side panel. The grid rows keep the header/footer fixed while content fills the rest.
layout.mainContentRegion: Main content area. The content region grows to fill the space between the header and footer.

overlay.desc: Dialogs, tooltips, menus, and floating panels. Overlays render above the page, trap focus where appropriate, and respect Escape and backdrop dismissal - all wired through signals for predictable open state.
overlay.dialogDesc: Modal dialog on the native <dialog> element with a title, body, and footer actions. Two-way bound open state.
overlay.deleteFileBody: This action cannot be undone. The file will be permanently removed from your workspace.
overlay.alertDialogDesc: A focused confirmation prompt with confirm/cancel actions and info or destructive variants.
overlay.saveChangesMsg: Your edits will be applied to the shared document.
overlay.deleteProjectMsg: This will permanently remove the project and all of its data.
overlay.tooltipDesc: A directive that shows a short hint on hover or focus. Position it on any side of the trigger.
overlay.hoverCardDesc: A rich popover that opens on hover or focus of its trigger - ideal for profile and link previews.
overlay.adaDesc: First computer programmer. Writes about analytical engines and algorithms.
overlay.sheetDesc: A panel that slides in from the left, right, or bottom edge. Great for filters, details, and navigation.
overlay.sheetBody: This panel slides in from the {{side}} edge.
overlay.dismissHint: Click the backdrop or the close button to dismiss.
overlay.dropdownMenuDesc: An actions menu anchored to a trigger button. Closes on selection, outside click, or Escape.
overlay.contextMenuDesc: A menu that opens at the pointer on right-click. Wire it to any surface via its show() method.
overlay.lightboxDesc: A full-screen image viewer with keyboard navigation. Click a thumbnail to open, or drive it via open state.
overlay.imperativeAlertDialogDesc: An injectable service that resolves a Promise<boolean> from a confirm prompt - great for quick inline confirmations.
overlay.commandPaletteDesc: A premium, keyboard-accessible command menu. Open it by clicking the button below or pressing Ctrl + K (or Cmd + K).

utilities.desc: Invisible-but-powerful directives and hooks for accessibility, layout, and interaction behavior - each demo below makes the effect visible and interactive.
utilities.visuallyHiddenDesc: Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers.
utilities.extraDescription: - extra description only announced to screen readers
utilities.toggleCompareHint: Toggle to compare: the directive removes it from view, not the DOM.
utilities.focusTrapDesc: Cycles Tab focus within the element so keyboard users stay contained.
utilities.trapHint: Turn the trap on, then press Tab - focus loops inside the box.
utilities.clickOutsideDesc: Emits when a click lands outside the host element - perfect for popovers.
utilities.popoverCloseText: I close when you click anywhere outside me.
utilities.clickOutsideHint: Open the panel, then click elsewhere on the page to dismiss it.
utilities.keyboardShortcutDesc: Binds a global key combo and fires when it matches.
utilities.copyToClipboardDesc: Copies a bound string to the clipboard on click.
utilities.scrollLockDesc: Locks the document scroll while active - e.g. behind a modal.
utilities.scrollHint: Toggle on, then try scrolling the page - it is frozen until you turn it off.
utilities.resizeHint: Resize the window to flip the match.
utilities.resizeObserverDesc: Streams the element's size whenever it changes.
utilities.dragCornerResize: Drag the corner to resize me
utilities.intersectionObserverDesc: Reports whether the element is visible within a scroll container.
utilities.layerProviderDesc: Establishes a positioned layer context for overlays and portals.
utilities.layerHint: The provider scopes z-index/layering for its children.
utilities.mediaQueryDesc: Reflects a CSS media query match as a live signal.
utilities.mediaThemeDesc: Applies a theme mode attribute from a prefers-* media query.
utilities.lazyLoadDesc: Defers rendering children until they scroll into view.
utilities.scrollToLoad: Scroll down to load the content…
utilities.loadedContent: ✅ Loaded! This markup only rendered once it entered the viewport.
utilities.lazyLoadCardsDesc: Each card below is wrapped in ngxsmk-lazy-load, so its markup is only created once it scrolls into the viewport - scroll the feed to watch them appear.
utilities.cardsScrollDown: Scroll down - cards load as they enter view…
utilities.shortcutLogHint: Press the shortcut to trigger it.
utilities.virtualScrollDesc: Zoneless virtualized viewport container for rendering thousands of items at 60 FPS.

ionic.title: Ionic integration
ionic.subtitle: Run the full NGXSMK component set inside an Ionic app: one provider call wires overlays, scrolling, and safe areas, and the token engine drives Ionic's own --ion-* variables from your NGXSMK theme.
ionic.setupBody: Add provideNgxsmkIonic() alongside provideIonicAngular(). It is the only wiring step.
ionic.setupScroll: Overlays lock the element ion-content actually scrolls, instead of the document body — where overflow: hidden is a no-op under Ionic.
ionic.setupOverlay: Imperative dialogs attach inside ion-app, so they stack above ion-modal instead of behind it.
ionic.setupSpinner: Button loading states render an <ion-spinner>, picking up the iOS or Material look Ionic resolves at runtime.
ionic.setupSafeArea: Safe-area tokens prefer Ionic's --ion-safe-area-* values, which report real insets in a Capacitor WebView where env() often returns nothing.
ionic.themeBody: applyIonicTheme() derives Ionic's variables from the same ThemeConfig your NGXSMK components use, so both component sets share one brand, one set of surfaces, and one dark mode.
ionic.rolesBody: Every Ionic color role receives the full six-variable set — base, rgb, contrast, contrast-rgb, shade, and tint — so color="primary" and color="danger" resolve completely, including readable text. NGXSMK's error semantic maps onto Ionic's danger role.
ionic.stepsBody: Ionic derives most borders, muted text, and pressed states from --ion-color-step-50 through -950, interpolated from background toward text. Without the ladder a themed app keeps stock greys; note how it inverts between light and dark.
